title: Even moment bound under moment conditions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\mu$ be a probability law on $\Omega$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Suppose $r$ is a positive integer, $\rho\ge0$, and $\rho^2\le 1/(2r-1)$. Assume that $\mathbb E_\mu[X^2]=1$, that every odd moment of order $2j-1$ vanishes for $1\le j\le r$, and that for each such $j$ the moment of order $2j$ is at most $\big((2r-1)^j\binom rj\big)/\binom{2r}{2j}$. Then, for all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, $\mathbb E_\mu[(a+\rho bX)^{2r}]\le(a^2+b^2)^r$.
hypotheses_covered: The second moment of $X$ under $\mu$ equals $1$
Odd moments of orders $2j-1$ vanish for $1\le j\le r$
Even moments of orders $2j$ satisfy the stated binomial upper bound for $1\le j\le r$
